AI Overview
Rocket Goal (also known as RocketGoal.io) is a free, browser-based 3D multiplayer car soccer game developed by PocketHavenGames. 
Key Features & Gameplay
Objective: Drive high-speed, rocket-powered vehicles to hit a giant ball into the opponent's net while defending your own. 
Game Modes: Features solo practice mode with guiding lines, online multiplayer (1v1, 2v2, 3v3 ranked modes), and party mode for private rooms. 
Vehicles: Includes 8 unlockable cars such as the starter Vortex, Overdrive, Crimson, Specter, Frostbite, Pulsewave, Blaze, and Nitron. 
Mechanics: Full 3D physics engine supporting aerial moves, wall-driving, jumping, nitro boosts, and flip resets. 
Platforms: Playable directly in web browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox) on PC, laptops, and tablets, as well as via mobile apps on Google Play and the Apple App Store.
